serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
BotConsole: Are you on the computer again?
YouConsole: Yeah, is something the matter?
BotConsole: Did you eat something after you connected me to your PC? 
YouConsole: No
BotConsole: According to my estimate, you are about to become malnourished. Please, take a break and eat something.
YouConsole: Sure, I will
I don’t feel that hungry right now. I will go eat something after playing some games or surfing the net.
BotConsole: Are you still there?
Let’s wait her out a little. She will assume that I went to get something to eat.
BotConsole: I will get mad if you won’t eat anything, you know?
D-Does she know that I’m ignoring her? T-There’s no way, right?
BotConsole: I know that you are still there.
